card.description: A manifestation of coherent, solid-state photonic matter. This is not ambient illumination but a hard, physical projection of ancient technology. It acts as a structural element, displacing atmosphere and ionizing particulate matter. A 'Solid Light' beam used by the Watchers, appearing as a massive, geometrically perfect column that connects the celestial to the terrestrial, capable of physical interaction and data transmission.
visual_anatomy: **Core Form:** A geometrically perfect, opaque cylinder or cone of blinding white luminance. It has distinct edges, lacking the soft falloff of natural light.
**Texture/Medium:** The air surrounding the light is thick with 'frozen dust'—suspended particles caught in the static charge of the beam.
**Interaction:** Where the light touches ground (obsidian/rock), the surface is not just lit but vitrified or heating rapidly. No diffusion; shadows are razor sharp.
**Color Palette:** Absolute white core (RGB 255,255,255) grading into faint ultra-violet or gold corruption at the very fringe of the coherence field.
evolution: Phase 1 (Default): The Solid Beam. A static, monolithic column of light acting as an elevator or data link. Heavy, humming, and physical.
card.prompt_block: cinematic macro shot of a solid light beam, absolute white opaque column of light cutting through darkness, heavy volumetric atmosphere, suspended dust particles frozen in mid-air near the beam edge, razor sharp geometric edges, heat shimmer, ground vitrification at contact point, ancient industrial mysticism, 8k, photorealistic, unreal engine 5 render, tactile atmosphere
